name: Why is surface smoothing important for a new concrete floor?

mainEntity.name: Why is surface smoothing important for a new concrete floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Surface smoothing is crucial for new concrete floors because it eliminates irregularities, trip hazards, and porous areas. A smooth surface ensures proper adhesion for sealants, coatings, or flooring materials like tile or hardwood, preventing premature wear or failure. It also improves the structural integrity of the top layer and makes the floor easier to clean and maintain. Without proper smoothing, the floor may develop cracks or become uneven over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: It eliminates irregularities, ensures proper adhesion for sealants or flooring materials, and improves the floor's structural integrity and ease of maintenance.
